title: "Hi, I'm Andrea Vasquez"

<img src="images/headshot.jpg" style="width:30%; border-radius:50%">

I'm a second-year MPH student in the Department of Epidemiology at Columbia University's Mailman School of Public Health.

My work focuses on infectious disease surveillance and cancer epidemiology. I've been working with tick-borne disease surveillance data at the NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene, and my thesis looks at second primary cancers in early-onset cancer cases using SEER data.

Take a look at my [resume](resume.html), or find me on [GitHub](https://github.com/adv2123).
